title.zh: 博通为Anthropic芯片采购安排融资并提供贷款
title.en: Broadcom arranges financing and extends loans for Anthropic chip purchases

current_state.zh: 该600亿美元AI芯片融资方案（现称“北极星项目”）已进入银团分销阶段，由美国银行、花旗集团和摩根士丹利牵头分销，其中约420亿美元博通支持的高级担保贷款已启动分销；黑石承诺向约180亿美元次级债务中的90亿美元部分提供资金，并获得超过10%的收益率，该债务以Anthropic未来五年芯片租赁付款为支持。
current_state.en: The $60 billion AI chip financing package (now called Project North Star) has entered syndication led by Bank of America, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley; the ~$42 billion Broadcom-backed senior secured loans have launched syndication; Blackstone has committed $9 billion to the ~$18 billion subordinated debt at a yield above 10%, backed by Anthropic's future five-year chip lease payments.

updates.title_zh: 博通已同意向Anthropic提供最高420亿美元贷款
updates.title_en: 博通已同意向Anthropic提供最高420亿美元贷款
updates.what_changed_zh: 博通已同意向Anthropic提供最高420亿美元的贷款，用于为这家AI实验室的基础设施支出提供资金。
updates.what_changed_en: Broadcom has agreed to extend up to $42 billion in loans to Anthropic to finance the AI lab's infrastructure spending.
updates.current_state_zh: 博通已同意向Anthropic提供最高420亿美元的贷款，用于为这家AI实验室的基础设施支出提供资金。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Broadcom has agreed to extend up to $42 billion in loans to Anthropic to finance the AI lab's infrastructure spending.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Broadcom has agreed to extend up to $42 billion in loans to Anthropic to finance the AI lab's infrastructure spending.

updates.title_zh: 博通着手筹集600亿美元，为Anthropic采购芯片提供资金
updates.title_en: 博通着手筹集600亿美元，为Anthropic采购芯片提供资金
updates.what_changed_zh: 博通正在安排一项600亿美元的AI芯片融资方案，其中包括420亿美元的高级担保债务和由黑石集团牵头的180亿美元次级债务，Anthropic是受益方之一。
updates.what_changed_en: Broadcom is arranging a $60 billion AI chip financing package, including $42B in senior secured debt and $18B in subordinated debt led by Blackstone, with Anthropic among the beneficiaries.
updates.current_state_zh: 博通正在安排一项600亿美元的AI芯片融资方案，其中包括420亿美元的高级担保债务和由黑石集团牵头的180亿美元次级债务，Anthropic是受益方之一。
updates.current_state_en: Broadcom is arranging a $60 billion AI chip financing package, including $42B in senior secured debt and $18B in subordinated debt led by Blackstone, with Anthropic among the beneficiaries.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Broadcom is arranging a $60 billion AI chip financing package, including $42B in senior secured debt and $18B in subordinated debt led by Blackstone, with Anthropic among the beneficiaries.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Broadcom is arranging a $60 billion AI chip financing package, including $42B in senior secured debt and $18B in subordinated debt led by Blackstone, with Anthropic among the beneficiaries.

updates.title_zh: 华尔街银团启动创纪录的600亿美元AI债务融资，旨在为Anthropic芯片租赁提供资金
updates.title_en: 华尔街银团启动创纪录的600亿美元AI债务融资，旨在为Anthropic芯片租赁提供资金
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国银行、花旗集团和摩根士丹利已启动向其他银行分销该600亿美元融资方案的份额，银团分销程序已开始；其中约420亿美元博通支持的高级担保贷款已启动分销，180亿美元次级债务将稍后推出。
updates.what_changed_en: Bank of America, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley have begun syndicating the $60 billion financing package to other banks; the ~$42 billion Broadcom-backed senior secured loans have launched syndication, while the $18 billion subordinated debt will be introduced later.
updates.current_state_zh: 该600亿美元AI芯片融资方案已进入银团分销阶段，由美国银行、花旗集团和摩根士丹利牵头向其他银行分销，其中约420亿美元博通支持的高级担保贷款已启动分销，180亿美元次级债务将稍后推出，黑石承诺为其中约90亿美元提供资金。
updates.current_state_en: The $60 billion AI chip financing package has entered syndication, led by Bank of America, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley distributing to other banks; the ~$42 billion Broadcom-backed senior secured loans have launched syndication, while the $18 billion subordinated debt will be introduced later, with Blackstone committing about $9 billion of it.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bank of America, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley began syndicating a record $60 billion debt financing package to support Anthropic's leasing of Google chips for AI compute, including $42 billion in Broadcom-backed senior secured loans and $18 billion in subordinated debt.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Bank of America, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley began syndicating a record $60 billion debt financing package to support Anthropic's leasing of Google chips for AI compute, including $42 billion in Broadcom-backed senior secured loans and $18 billion in subordinated debt.

updates.title_zh: Anthropic据悉为600亿美元芯片融资向黑石提供逾10%收益率
updates.title_en: Anthropic据悉为600亿美元芯片融资向黑石提供逾10%收益率
updates.what_changed_zh: 该600亿美元芯片融资计划被称为“北极星项目”，Anthropic向黑石提供超过10%的收益率，黑石基金承诺投资90亿美元购买以Anthropic未来五年芯片租赁付款为支持的债务，占约180亿美元次级贷款的一半；资金用于采购约1.5吉瓦谷歌TPU。
updates.what_changed_en: The $60B chip financing plan is called "Project North Star"; Anthropic is offering Blackstone a yield above 10%; Blackstone funds commit $9B to purchase debt backed by Anthropic's future five-year chip lease payments, half of the ~$18B subordinated tranche; proceeds to acquire ~1.5 GW of Google TPUs.
updates.current_state_zh: 该600亿美元AI芯片融资方案（现称“北极星项目”）已进入银团分销阶段，由美国银行、花旗集团和摩根士丹利牵头分销，其中约420亿美元博通支持的高级担保贷款已启动分销；黑石承诺向约180亿美元次级债务中的90亿美元部分提供资金，并获得超过10%的收益率，该债务以Anthropic未来五年芯片租赁付款为支持。
updates.current_state_en: The $60 billion AI chip financing package (now called Project North Star) has entered syndication led by Bank of America, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley; the ~$42 billion Broadcom-backed senior secured loans have launched syndication; Blackstone has committed $9 billion to the ~$18 billion subordinated debt at a yield above 10%, backed by Anthropic's future five-year chip lease payments.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic is reportedly offering Blackstone a yield above 10% on a $60 billion debt financing, dubbed Project North Star, to acquire roughly 1.5 gigawatts of Google TPUs, with Blackstone's funds committing $9 billion of an approximately $18 billion subordinated tranche.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic is reportedly offering Blackstone a yield above 10% on a $60 billion debt financing, dubbed Project North Star, to acquire roughly 1.5 gigawatts of Google TPUs, with Blackstone's funds committing $9 billion of an approximately $18 billion subordinated tranche.
